items.title: Solana's Institutional Push Forward
points: Solana Foundation launched a DvP (delivery-versus-payment: a settlement method ensuring simultaneous exchange of assets) program with JPMorgan input, providing an open-source API standard for banks to settle trades atomically with finality in seconds versus days required by traditional clearinghouses.

Follows recent institutional wins: Kraken settled tokenized stock derivatives on Solana for overseas customers; BlackRock launched a tokenized money market fund (fund shares represented as blockchain tokens) on the network in August.
Program aims to standardize bank adoption of Solana for institutional settlement, addressing the plumbing for large financial institutions.

items.title: Slowing Treasury Accumulation Amid Institutional Build-Out
points: DeFi Development Corp (Nasdaq-listed SOL treasury holder) added only 26,203 SOL tokens last week, worth ~$3 million—50% less than the prior week and 75% less than mid-September buying rates.
Latest SEC filing shows total stash grew just 1% to 2.56 million SOL, indicating significantly reduced accumulation despite institutional product launches.
A disconnect is emerging: institutional infrastructure is developing faster than the second-largest SOL holder is building its treasury position.

items.title: Security Vulnerabilities Persist Across DeFi
points: Flash loan attacks (exploits using uncollateralized borrowed funds to manipulate prices or drain protocols) drained $1.2 billion from DeFi (decentralized finance) between 2020-2024 across 20+ billion transactions analyzed.
Attack sophistication and unpredictability increased over the period, indicating adversaries continuously adapt methods to evade detection.

items.title: Regulatory Pullback on Crypto Surveillance
points: Treasury's FinCEN withdrew the long-pending 'unhosted wallet' rule (a proposed requirement to report self-custody crypto transfers to regulators) after sustained industry opposition.
A separate crypto mixer surveillance proposal (targeting privacy-focused transaction tools) was also withdrawn, representing a significant regulatory retreat on user surveillance mechanisms.

items.title: SOL vs. Silver Race to $150
points: Prediction markets give SOL 78% odds of reaching $150 before silver does.
SOL is up 13.6% monthly to $120.48 and needs a 25% gain to hit $150.
Silver is down 7.5% to $61.28 and would need to double in price to reach $150.

items.title: BlackRock's AI-Bitcoin Vision
points: BlackRock, the $15 trillion asset manager, suggests AI agents could use stablecoins (cryptocurrency pegged to stable values like the U.S. dollar) for everyday transactions while holding Bitcoin as a long-term store of value.
The model separates stablecoins (fast, efficient transaction layer) from Bitcoin (settlement and wealth preservation layer), similar to how institutions currently use gold and foreign reserves.
This signals growing convergence between AI infrastructure development and enterprise-scale cryptocurrency adoption.

issues.subject: 👀 BlackRock Says AI Agents May Save in Bitcoin

headlines: BlackRock, the $15 trillion asset manager, reports AI agents could use stablecoins (cryptocurrency pegged to stable values like the U.S. dollar) for everyday transactions while holding Bitcoin as a long-term store of value.
The distinction suggests a two-layer strategy: volatile, efficient stablecoins for AI agent operations and Bitcoin as a hedge against inflation and currency devaluation.
Major institutional interest in Bitcoin's role within AI infrastructure signals growing convergence between artificial intelligence development and cryptocurrency adoption at enterprise scale.

sections.title: BlackRock's AI-Bitcoin Vision
points: $15 trillion asset manager identified stablecoins as the transaction layer for AI agents conducting frequent, small-value operations.
Bitcoin positioned as the settlement and wealth preservation layer, similar to how institutions currently use gold and foreign reserves.
Model separates speed/efficiency (stablecoins) from long-term value storage (Bitcoin), addressing scalability concerns that have limited crypto adoption.
